Rebuild this vault from its phrase and the indexer.

USAGE
  sennit recover [flags]

FLAGS
  --embed          Regenerate search vectors as records are recovered, so they
                   are findable by meaning and not only by id (default true)

VAULT FLAGS
  --home dir       Vault directory (default ~/.sennit)
  --indexer url    Indexer URL (default https://sia.storage)
  --offline        Work from this device only, without contacting the indexer

OUTPUT FLAGS
  --color when     When to colour output: auto, always or never (default auto)
  --verbose        Show timings, read tiers and other detail

EXAMPLES
  $ sennit recover
  $ sennit recover --embed=false
